name: Evaluate and score written essays and exam responses
description: Users asked to evaluate, score, and provide specific feedback on their written essays and exam responses, often targeting standardized tests like IELTS or TOEFL with detailed rubrics or band scores. Many requests also included requests for revised or polished versions of the texts to improve grammar, structure, and content.
